title: The planet hiding in plain sight
caption: Uranus was catalogued as a star in 1690, then found to be a planet in 1781.

beats.head: Uranus was logged as a *star* for nearly a century.
It's faintly visible to the *naked eye*.
beats.sub: Under very dark skies, if you know where to look.

beats.head: In 1781, an astronomer spotted a strange little *disk*.
beats.sub: The first planet ever discovered with a telescope.

beats.head: It doubled the size of the known *solar system*.
And it rolls around the Sun on its *side*.
Sometimes the one you want was there *all along*.
beats.sub: You just had to look twice.

beats.head: Send this to the one you *almost* missed.
